description: Comparison of the three LMX1B LIR candidates and the competing ELM motifs inside 308-317
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
C=pd.read_csv("LMX1B_LIR_candidate_comparison.csv")
elm=pd.read_csv("ELM_all_LMX1B.csv")
w=elm[(elm.stop>=305)&(elm.start<=320)].sort_values("start")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.4), gridspec_kw=dict(width_ratios=[1.15,1]))

a=ax[0]
cands=C.candidate.tolist()
xs=np.arange(3)
a.bar(xs-0.2, C.mean_pLDDT_window, 0.4, color="#4299e1", label="mean pLDDT (window, lower = disordered)")
a.bar(xs+0.2, C.burial_contact_number_core*5, 0.4, color="#ed8936", label="burial contact number x5 (higher = buried)")
a.set_xticks(xs); a.set_xticklabels([f"{c}\n{core}" for c,core in zip(C.candidate,C.core)])
a.axhline(50,color="grey",ls=":")
a.legend(fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel("value")
for i,(c,ok,ins) in enumerate(zip(C.candidate, C.ELM_canonical_LIG_LIR_Gen_1, C.inside_deleted_308_317)):
    a.text(i, 100, f"ELM canonical: {ok}\nin 308-317: {ins}", ha="center", fontsize=8)
a.set_ylim(0,120)
a.set_title("Three LIR candidates in LMX1B: only Y309 lies in the deleted segment,\nand it is the one that fails the canonical consensus", fontsize=10)

b=ax[1]
b.set_xlim(304,321); b.set_ylim(-0.5, len(w)+0.5)
seq="MEGMMASYTPLAPPQQQIV"
L=json.load(open("seqs.json"))["LMX1B_HUMAN"]
for i in range(304,321):
    b.text(i, len(w)+0.1, L[i-1], ha="center", fontsize=9, family="monospace")
    b.text(i, len(w)+0.6, str(i) if i%4==0 else "", ha="center", fontsize=6, color="grey")
cols={"LIG_LIR_Nem_3":"#c53030"}
for k,(_,r) in enumerate(w.iterrows()):
    y=len(w)-1-k
    c = "#c53030" if r.is_filtered else "#2b6cb0"
    b.plot([r.start, r.stop],[y,y], lw=7, color=c, solid_capstyle="butt", alpha=.75)
    b.text(321.2, y, r.elm_identifier + (" (filtered by ELM: nematode-only)" if r.is_filtered else ""),
           va="center", fontsize=8, color=c)
b.axvspan(307.5,317.5, color="#f6ad55", alpha=.25)
b.set_yticks([]); b.set_xlabel("residue")
for s in ["top","right","left"]: b.spines[s].set_visible(False)
b.set_title("ELM motif predictions in LMX1B 304-320 (orange = deleted 308-317)", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(C.to_string(index=False))
